run_calculate_runner: run a CalculateRunner to execute calculations and save results to the results directory
implement_calculate_method: implement the abstract calculate method in a subclass to perform ASE calculator computations
implement_write_results_method: implement the abstract write_results method in a subclass to save calculation output to files
load_state_from_checkpoint: load a previously saved calculation state from a checkpoint directory to resume interrupted jobs
create_calculate_runner_subclass: create a subclass of CalculateRunner that implements calculate and write_results for custom calculations
